jumpstart.name: Flathub Remote
jumpstart.desc: Ensure Flathub is configured — primary app source on Bazzite

jumpstart.name: Toolbox Container (Fedora)
jumpstart.desc: Mutable container for CLI tools. Required for pip/cargo/npm on immutable Bazzite.
jumpstart.cmd: toolbox create tinker && toolbox enter tinker

jumpstart.name: Node.js via nvm (in toolbox)
jumpstart.desc: nvm → Node LTS inside toolbox container
jumpstart.cmd: toolbox run --container tinker bash -c "curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.7/install.sh | bash && source ~/.bashrc && nvm install --lts"

jumpstart.name: Rust + Cargo (in toolbox)
jumpstart.cmd: toolbox run --container tinker bash -c "curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y"

jumpstart.name: Ollama 0.17.1+
jumpstart.desc: Layer via rpm-ostree OR run in toolbox
jumpstart.cmd: toolbox run --container tinker bash -c "curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh"

jumpstart.name: RTK (in toolbox)
jumpstart.desc: Compresses command output for AI coding agents (not the 'rtk' crate on crates.io)
jumpstart.cmd: toolbox run --container tinker bash -c "cargo install --git https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk"

jumpstart.name: Decky Loader
jumpstart.desc: Steam Deck plugin loader — pre-installed on Bazzite

jumpstart.name: Whisper STT (toolbox)
jumpstart.cmd: toolbox run --container tinker pip install openai-whisper

jumpstart.name: Piper TTS (toolbox)
jumpstart.cmd: toolbox run --container tinker pip install piper-tts

jumpstart.name: ROCm (RX 6600)
jumpstart.cmd: rpm-ostree install rocm-opencl rocm-hip && echo "export HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=10.3.0" >> ~/.bashrc

jumpstart.name: Steam (pre-installed)
jumpstart.cmd: # Pre-installed on Bazzite. Check: flatpak list | grep Steam
